plan.summary: Two capitalization fixes from Dots' audit of the Deep Research answers (Oct 18), each checked against the primary source: Liberation gets the $5,525,000 its SEC Form D/A states as the amount capitalized; Dolly moves from the $30M tryout-plus-Broadway total to the $17M the NY Post reports for Broadway.
steps: Set Liberation capitalization and source from the SEC Form D/A
Set Dolly capitalization to the Broadway-only $17M, with source and notes

actions.description: SEC Form D/A states the offering capitalized at $5,525,000.

actions.newValue: SEC Form D/A for Knitting Circle Broadway LLC, the producing company of Liberation (managing members Daryl Roth, Eva Price and Rachel Sussman), filed Jan 5, 2026: "Offering capitalized at $5,525,000" (minimum $5,000,000, maximum $6,250,000). https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2075411/000207541126000001/primary_doc.xml
actions.description: Primary filing; the LLC's managing members are Liberation's lead producers.
$30M is the Nashville tryout plus Broadway; NY Post gives $17M for Broadway.

actions.oldValue: Broadway Journal (Philip Boroff, Aug 12, 2026): "The Dolly Parton musical Dolly ($30 million)"; the figure includes its out-of-town tryout. https://www.broadwayjournal.com/p/broadway-stages-a-musical-comeback
actions.newValue: New York Post (Johnny Oleksinski, Jul 22, 2026): "Dolly"'s combined price tag for its Nashville tryout and New York productions is a hefty $30 million, including $17 million for Broadway. This is the Broadway figure; the $30 million (Broadway Journal, Aug 12, 2026) includes the tryout. https://nypost.com/2026/07/22/entertainment/two-risky-30-million-musicals-are-battling-on-broadway-dolly-and-paddington/
actions.description: Broadway-only figure, keeps the combined total for context.

actions.oldValue: Capitalized at $30 million including its out-of-town tryout (Broadway Journal, Aug 2026).
actions.newValue: Capitalized at $17 million for Broadway (NY Post, Jul 2026); $30 million including the Nashville tryout (Broadway Journal, Aug 2026).
